title: Convert progress
summary: ConvRulesEditor Convert tab: per-step progress (unit, book, phase, elapsed) on the status bar and the tab
intro: See where a long Convert run is and how long each unit takes.

questions.ask: Why is my conversion taking so long, and which unit is it on?
questions.command: Watch the Convert tab progress line in ConvRulesEditor.exe

questions.ask: Why does the progress line say 'applying units 1-8 of 20 in one batch' and not move for a while?
questions.command: Batch mode: one convert-apply per book over up to 8 units, and the engine reports no progress inside the call; set CONVRULES_BATCH=off before starting ConvRulesEditor.exe for per-unit progress
